description: Macquarie Harbour WHA oxygen logger dataset is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. Fixed position oxygen and water temperature logger data from the Macquarie Harbour World Heritage Area (WHA). Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are Concentration of dissolved oxygen (adjusted), Maugean Skate, Temperate Reef, Water Quality. It offers 10 resource(s) in html, png, wfs, wms, zip. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
